text: Artificial intelligence is changing how we work. Many companies now use automation to handle boring, repeated tasks, such as organising data or answering simple customer questions. This saves time and lets employees focus on more interesting work. There are also productivity tools that help us write emails, plan projects, or check information faster. However, AI is not replacing people completely. Instead, human-AI collaboration is becoming common, where workers use AI to support their decisions. Of course, some jobs are changing or even disappearing, so employees need to learn new skills. In the future, working well with AI will be an important ability for almost everyone.
